added.t: In the normal course of business, we engage in discussions with third parties relating to possible divestitures, acquisitions and other strategic transactions.
The concentration of our customer base could adversely affect our financial condition and operating results.

If we fail to maintain an effective system of internal controls, we may not be able to accurately report our financial results, which could lead to a loss of investor confidence in our financial statements and have an adverse effect on our stock price.

With respect to divestitures or dispositions, we continually assess the strategic fit of our existing businesses and products and may divest or otherwise dispose of businesses or products for strategic, financial or other reasons.
We derive a substantial portion of our revenue from a limited number of customers.
Effective internal controls are necessary for us to provide reliable and accurate financial statements and to effectively prevent fraud.

removed.t: As of the filing of this Form 10-K, there were no unresolved comments from the Staff of the SEC.
